confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from aggregated or crowd-sourced Lisbon sources (Numbeo-style averages, Hikersbay, Expatistan, Bootsnall, guide sites) and vary widely by venue. Cocktail and wine anchors lean on guide ranges rather than a Lisbon-specific index. EUR figures were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD/EUR, which was not sourced from a search. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not from opening the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon-specific food and drink basis from the cost-of-living and guide sources above, with cocktail and wine partly benchmarked to local beer pricing. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from Lisbon's July peak-season price level, with no searches for accommodation prices.
